title: Chlorophyll Extraction in Cyanobacteria
author: Nicolas M Schmelling
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.ywvfxe6

steps.title: Centrifuge sample
steps.instruction: Take 1 ml of cyanobacterial culture and spin it at 14,000 rpm for 5 minutes.

steps.title: Remove supernatant and resuspend pellet
steps.instruction: Discard 0.9 ml of the supernatant, then resuspend the pellet in the remaining 100 µl.

steps.title: Add methanol and vortex
steps.instruction: Add 0.9 ml of 100 % methanol to the resuspended pellet and mix thoroughly by vortexing.

steps.title: Incubate in dark
steps.instruction: Incubate the mixture in the dark at 4 °C for 30 minutes (in a refrigerator).

steps.title: Second centrifugation
steps.instruction: Spin the samples again at 14,000 rpm for 5 minutes.

steps.title: Measure absorbance
steps.instruction: Transfer the supernatant to a cuvette, measure the extinction at 665 nm, and use 90 % methanol as the reference solution.
